profile.ja: 次元侵略者・ブレインフレーヤーによって支配された終末世界の相州蛇子。元対魔忍たちで結成された組織“Bandit”の実戦部隊隊長。獣遁の術“Devilfish”と彼女の中に眠る蛇神の力が覚醒し、魔神蛇子が爆誕。蛇神と名乗らないのには深い理由と心の傷があるので取り扱い注意である。覚醒の影響で、自称150センチ、実際は149センチだった身長は170センチにまで伸びたが、寒くなると元の蛇子の姿に戻ってしまう。
profile.en: She is Aishu Hebiko from a world dominated by the dimensional invader Brain Flayer. She is the captain of the combat unit of "Bandit", an organization formed by former Taimanin. The awakening of the beast ninja art "Devilfish" and the power of the snake god within her has given rise to Magic God Hebiko. There is a deep reason and emotional scar behind her not calling herself a snake god, so handle with care. Due to the effects of her awakening, her height, which she claims to be 150 cm and actually was 149 cm, has grown to 170 cm, but she reverts to her original form when it gets cold.

text.ja: ふうまちゃん……久しぶり。ふふふ、大きくなったから見違えちゃったかな？　もう小さいなんて言わせないよ。これからは
text.en: Fuuma-chan... it's been a while. Hehehe, I've grown so much, you might not recognize me? I won't let you call me small anymore. From now on,

text.ja: 寒い時は部屋の暖房をつけっぱなしにしなきゃなんだよね……寒いのはほんとにダメなの
text.en: I have to keep the heater on in my room all the time when it's cold... I just can't stand the cold.

text.ja: え？　普通のタコ足じゃないのかって？　ほら、この柄を見たらわかるでしょ？　蛇の力なんだってば！
text.en: What? You think these tentacles are normal? Look at this pattern - it's the power of the snake, I tell you!

text.ja: ふうまちゃんはまだ学生なんだから、私に敬語を使ってもいいんだよ？　なんなら蛇子様って呼んでもいいんだから♪
text.en: Fuuma-chan, you're still a student, so you can use polite language with me if you want. You can even call me Hebiko-sama if you like.

text.ja: ふふ、あの頃は大人っぽく見えることもあったふうまちゃんだけど、今は蛇子の方が大人なんだな～って
text.en: Hehe, back then, Fuuma-chan sometimes looked like an adult, but now I'm the one who looks more grown-up.

text.ja: また、独立遊撃隊でふうまちゃんと鹿之助ちゃんと一緒に任務かぁ……懐かしいね♪
text.en: We're going on a mission with Fuuma-chan and Shikanosuke-chan from the independent strike team again... it's nostalgic.

text.ja: ふうまちゃんは独立遊撃隊の隊長だけど、私も“Ｂａｎｄｉｔ”の隊長を務めていたんだよ
text.en: Fuuma-chan is the captain of the independent strike team, but I was also the captain of "Bandit".

text.ja: この力が目ざめた時の事は思い出したくないけど……今は、ふうまちゃんの為に使えるのが嬉しいな
text.en: I don't want to remember what happened when I first awakened to this power... but now, I'm happy I can use it for Fuuma-chan's sake.

text.ja: ああ、だめぇ見ないでぇ……こんな姿見られたくないのぉっ……！
text.en: Ah, no, don't look... I don't want you to see me like this...

text.ja: んぅ、あぁ、ヌルヌルがすごいぃ……ふぁっ、やぁ、おマンコ疼いて来ちゃうぅっ
text.en: Mmm, it feels so good... it's all slippery... ah, my pussy is getting all tingly...

text.ja: ち、チンポぉっ、チンポ欲しいぃっ♪　タコ足みたいにふっといチンポちょうだいぃっ♪
text.en: I want a dick, I want a dick... a thick, tentacle-like dick, please...
